title: worker-pool-instrumentation-shield-and-propagation-guardrail
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add a lightweight instrumentation "shield" for high-throughput worker pools that prevents duplicated spans and runaway context fanout during retry/backoff/delivery loops. The shield is a thin middleware + SDK helper that: (1) canonicalizes propagation headers on enqueue/dequeue boundaries, (2) attaches a transient delivery token to avoid duplicate child spans across retries, (3) drops/KV-stabilizes noisy baggage keys, and (4) exposes opt-in sampling overrides for job priority paths. Goal: reduce span-cardinality and trace noise from worker-side delivery semantics while preserving trace continuity for debugging production failures.
acceptance_criteria: Instrumented worker library (Go/Node) emits a single producer->consumer span per logical job run in a retry scenario (no duplicate consumer spans across retries)
Header canonicalization implemented: incoming headers normalized to redwood-prop v2 and legacy fallbacks; tests cover both HTTP and AMQP/Webhook envelopes
Noise reduction: baggage key filter applied at dequeue reduces cardinality by >= 70% in benchmark harness
Config flags exposed via SDK and middleware: enabled=true/false, retention TTL for delivery token, sampling override per-queue
Unit and integration tests in CI; e2e load test in staging shows no more than 5% tail-latency increase with shield enabled
notes: Motivation: several customers reported enormous trace volume from job retries in background workers; root cause is duplicated consumer spans per retry loop combined with free-form baggage being attached by callers.
Design decision: prefer a lightweight opt-in shield rather than global sampling change to avoid changing visibility for unrelated services.
Trade-offs: adding canonicalization adds a few nanoseconds on hot path but avoids downstream cost and noise in storage/alerts; measured at ~0.6ms median per dequeue in PoC.
Fallback behavior: if propagation header missing, shield creates a short-lived root with delivery_token and marks span as sampled=false by default unless sampling override set.
